title: Queb3
tagline: A better Quora, for communities who want to reward wisdom sharers.
description:
Problem(s):
• Searching for answers to life used to be a great experience on Quora, but now the search results are filled with relevant, but sponsored answers.
• The # of upvotes is nice, but folks with a lot of wisdom to share deserve a sustainable way to continue sharing their wisdom on specific topics.
• Niched communities need their own forum, where members can feel comfortable asking OR answering any vulnerable questions.

Answer: 
Queb3; a better Quora, for communities - where a niched community can create a forum and members can be rewarded for asking and answering questions, either publicly or privately.

If you share a great question or answer, you can get upvotes/token rewards. If you earn enough upvotes, you will eventually get a Proof of Wisdom for a specific community. This Proof of Wisdom credential allows future users to ask questions directly to you - helping you earn even more tokens and reputation in the community!

As you can see, the possibilities with Queb3 and Proof of Wisdom in niched communities are endless. 

For end users - say goodbye to bad UX due to sponsored ads, and say hello to more golden nuggets of wisdom/answers from people you can trust.

For answerers - say goodbye to being a broke influencer on Quora, and say hello to a more sustainable way of sharing your wisdom.
how_its_made:
Although we were unable to implement our tech stack, here is our tech stack:

- Front-end: Remix of Refract
- Identity: Lens Profile
- To query user data like their questions & answer: The Graph
- To upvote/token reward answers: Lens Collect
-  To issue a Proof of Wisdom reward: Lens
- To ask or answer a question anonymously: Polygon ID
- To receive notifications on when users interact with your Q/A: Push
